name: Layout Placer
description: Place objects during editor playtest; save gimmicks together with your latest playtest route, and paste them automatically when your click effects and route match the saved route.

offset-x.name: X offset
offset-x.description: Place objects this many units ahead of the player (a block is 30).

auto-paste.name: Auto paste gimmicks
auto-paste.description: Paste saved gimmicks during a playtest when your clicks match.

window-frames.name: Effect window (frames)
window-frames.description: All click effects of a gimmick must happen within this many frames of each other (1 frame = 1 / Frame rate seconds).

fps.name: Frame rate (fps)
fps.description: How many frames per second 'frames' mean in the settings. 60 = normal GD frames; use your game's FPS / TPS if you count frames at another rate.

min-gap.name: Minimum gap (units)
min-gap.description: Minimum distance between two pasted gimmicks.

spacing.name: Object spacing (units)
spacing.description: A gimmick is only pasted when the nearest other object in front of and behind it is at least this far away in X (a block is 30). Objects it would overlap in X count as 0.

spacing-deco.name: Spacing: include decoration
spacing-deco.description: Also keep the spacing from decoration objects (off = only gameplay objects count).

stretch.name: Vary spacing
stretch.description: Randomly stretch or squeeze a pasted gimmick horizontally (80% to 120%). Off = pasted exactly as saved.

predict-orbs.name: Place orbs ahead
predict-orbs.description: While you fall along a route that looks like the start of a saved gimmick, place its orb ahead of you and wait. If you click it the gimmick goes on; if you do not, you fly past and the orb is removed.

show-generated.name: Show generated objects
show-generated.description: During a playtest, keep every object created along the path visible.

safety-margin.name: Safety margin (units)
safety-margin.description: Spikes and slopes of a pasted gimmick that come closer than this to your route (with your current hitbox: normal, mini, wave, mini wave) are left out, and so are blocks your route runs into. Blocks you stand on or land on (touching your route from above or below) are kept.

route-tolerance.name: Route tolerance (units)
route-tolerance.description: How closely your route must match the saved route of a gimmick (average vertical difference).

lead-in.name: Lead-in (units)
lead-in.description: How far BEFORE a gimmick's first object your click effects still belong to it (e.g. the jump before a spike).

debug.name: Debug messages
debug.description: Show a small message for every click and every detected click effect.
